description: Rothco Sportsman’s Watchband Wrist Compass can slide onto most watchbands to make your watchband the perfect accessory while hiking or camping outdoors. Made with a hard plastic case, the watchband compass is durable and built to last the long outdoor retreats. Hiking compass measures: 2.3cm X 2.3cm X 1.2cm.
